headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 15, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins in a thrilling 1-0 victory. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 win over the Boston Red Sox, and the Chicago White Sox took down the Detroit Tigers 9-5.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with Vladimir Guerrero Jr. being placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. Abner Uribe, Colt Emerson, Davis Martin, Matt Chapman, Trevor McDonald, Garrett Whitlock, and James Outman have also been added to their respective teams' injured lists.

The Baltimore Orioles made a trade, acquiring Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox as part of a deal involving the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Kansas City Royals also made a trade, acquiring Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 0-3 loss to the Chicago Cubs, marking their defeat in the matchup. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns pitching a stellar 7.0 innings, striking out 8 and allowing 0 earned runs. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a crucial double that scored the game's only run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Endy Rodríguez contributed to the Pirates' win.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the charge at the plate. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Vladimir Guerrero Jr. Lands on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
